words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我们先吃饭吧。(Wǒmen xiān chīfàn ba.) — Let's eat first.
我很好，你呢？(Wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne?) — I'm good, and you?
好啊，我们一起去！(Hǎo a, wǒmen yìqǐ qù!) — Great, let's go together!
请进，你先坐吧。(Qǐng jìn, nǐ xiān zuò ba.) — Please come in, have a seat first.
时间到了，我们走吧。(Shíjiān dào le, wǒmen zǒu ba.) — It's time, let's go.
你是明天下午到，对吧？(Nǐ shì míngtiān xiàwǔ dào, duì ba?) — You arrive tomorrow afternoon, right?
这家餐厅挺好吃的，是吧？(Zhè jiā cāntīng tǐng hǎochī de, shì ba?) — This restaurant is quite tasty, right?
行吧，那就按你说的办。(Xíng ba, nà jiù àn nǐ shuō de bàn.) — Alright then, let's do it your way.
你明天能来？太好了！(Nǐ míngtiān néng lái? Tài hǎo le!) — You can come tomorrow? Fantastic!
周末去不去爬山？— 看情况吧。(Zhōumò qù bu qù páshān? — Kàn qíngkuàng ba.) — Hiking this weekend? — We'll see how it goes.

words.English Meaning: I see / so that's how it is
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 原来是这样啊，我明白了。(Yuánlái shì zhèyàng a, wǒ míngbai le.) — Oh so that's how it is, I understand now.

words.English Meaning: no problem at all / don't worry
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 没事啊，不用客气。(Méishì a, bú yòng kèqi.) — No problem at all, don't mention it.
快点吧，电影要开始了。(Kuài diǎnr ba, diànyǐng yào kāishǐ le.) — Hurry up a bit, the movie is starting.
妈妈提醒的事情我都知道了。(Māma tíxǐng de shìqing wǒ dōu zhīdào le.) — I got everything mom reminded me of.
明晚一起吃饭？— 行啊！(Míngwǎn yìqǐ chīfàn? — Xíng a!) — Dinner tomorrow night? — Sure thing!
好吧，那我先回去了。(Hǎo ba, nà wǒ xiān huíqù le.) — Okay then, I'll head back first.

words.English Meaning: where are you headed? / where to go?
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 放假大家都在商量去哪儿呢。(Fàngjià dàjiā dōu zài shāngliang qù nǎr ne.) — Everyone is discussing where to go during break.
怎么说呢，感觉还行吧。(Zěnme shuō ne, gǎnjué hái xíng ba.) — How should I put it, felt just okay.
谁说的啊，根本没有这回事。(Shéi shuō de a, gēnběn méiyǒu zhè huí shì.) — Who said that?! That's not the case at all.
准备工作做得差不多吧。(Zhǔnbèi gōngzuò zuò de chàbuduō ba.) — The preparations are pretty much done.
这件事我们明天开会再说吧。(Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen míngtiān kāihuì zàishuō ba.) — Let's discuss this matter in tomorrow's meeting.
这盘红烧肉真香啊！(Zhè pán hóngshāoròu zhēn xiāng a!) — This braised pork smells so good!
你一个人坐在这里想什么呢？(Nǐ yí ge rén zuò zài zhèlǐ xiǎng shénme ne?) — Sitting here alone, what are you thinking about?
既然买不到票，那就算了吧。(Jìrán mǎi bú dào piào, nà jiù suàn le ba.) — Since tickets are sold out, let's forget it.
